meaning:
1) to be bereaved, make childless, miscarry
1a) (Qal) to be bereaved
1b) (Piel)
1b1) to make childless
1b2) to cause barrenness, show barrenness or abortion
1b3) to miscarry
1c) (Hiphil) miscarrying (participle)
glosses: have deprived me of my sons

renderings.bsb: You have deprived me of my sons

renderings.kjv: There shall nothing cast their young

renderings.bsb: to rob you of your children
renderings.kjv: which shall rob you of your children

renderings.bsb: and they will leave you childless

elsewhere.note: until your brother’s anger turns away from you, and he forgets what you have done to him. Then I will send, and get you from there. Why should I be bereaved of…
No one will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days.
I will send the wild animals among you, which will rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and make you few in number. Your roads will become…
Outside the sword will bereave, and in the rooms, terror on both young man and virgin, the nursing infant with the gray-haired man.
Samuel said, “As your sword has made women childless, so your mother will be childless among women!” Then Samuel cut Agag in pieces before Yahweh in Gilgal.
The men of the city said to Elisha, “Behold, please, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord sees; but the water is bad, and the land is barren.”
Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.
I have winnowed them with a fan in the gates of the land. I have bereaved them of children. I have destroyed my people. They didn’t return from their ways.
